selection.edition: international Cochrane Archie Review Document API
selection.ownership: Cochrane (UK-based international health-evidence charity). Archie at archie.cochrane.org is the global Review Document API, not a mainland-China edition.

research.searchCoverage: Official Cochrane Archie Review Document API Basic-or-Bearer auth, GET /rest/reviews/{id}/metadata|versions|roles|translations, Archie retirement notice, UK Cochrane identity, and dated incident search reviewed on 2026-09-13. Archie Cochrane Motors and Cochrane Global hits are different organizations. Dual auth and XML healthcheck remain unexpressible. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.

research.edition: international Cochrane Archie Review Document API
research.searchCoverage: Official Archie Review Document API documents HTTPS Basic or Bearer OAuth2. Pinned OpenConnector switches on authMethod. Native cannot express that switch and has no oauth block for this custom_credential shape. Pinned validator GET /rest/reviews returns XML. JSON metadata/versions/roles/translations all require a reviewId.
remainingGates: credentials: official and pinned source require HTTP Basic or Bearer OAuth2 via custom_credential authMethod. Native http.auth can express only one scheme, and native oauth is not supported for this provider shape.

operationQuality: pinned credential validator uses GET /rest/reviews?myRole=Author&published=false with Accept application/xml. Native JSON contract cannot consume that XML list. Every JSON operation requires reviewId, so there is no cheap credential-only JSON healthcheck.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.
